entries.title: Navigate and edit records more consistently
entries.description: Fleet and directory pages now use clearer, consistent controls and forms, including the In Yard status.

entries.title: Manage users for your current business
entries.description: The Users page now shows the relevant people and roles for the business you are working in.

entries.title: Browse large user lists
entries.description: User lists are now paginated, making them faster and easier to navigate.

entries.title: Work with machines more easily
entries.description: Machine lists, filters, reading statuses, and capture controls are now clearer and more consistent. Filter menus also stay within the screen.

entries.title: Reset your password
entries.description: The password reset option is available again, with clearer request feedback and reliable navigation from reset links.
